ideas.hook: Did you know that Ancient Egyptian eyeliner was actually a potent medical treatment?
ideas.why: It leverages the high-performing 'scientific mystery' format while keeping the cinematic tone focused on daily life and health.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egypt Never Used Wheels on Sand
ideas.hook: Why did one of the smartest civilizations in history refuse to use wheels for their greatest monuments?
ideas.why: This challenges common assumptions with a counter-intuitive historical fact, mirroring the high-engagement 'how things worked' pattern.

ideas.topic: What Was Actually Inside a Pharaoh's 'Lunchbox'?
ideas.hook: Ever wonder what the most powerful person in the world ate for breakfast four thousand years ago?
ideas.why: Personalized history topics involving food are highly relatable and tap into the audience's curiosity about human experiences behind the myths.
